title: Space Economy & Aerospace
businessQuestion: How does sub-$100/kg launch pricing unlock manufacturing and orbital compute?
investorQuestion: Which satellite constellations generate recurring terrestrial connectivity revenues?
overview: Launch costs set the tempo: records split between reusable launch, satellite systems and in-space manufacturing, with several already commercial. Company coverage is dense relative to technology count, reflecting a sector where many suppliers sell into a small number of programmes. Government contracts and constellation refresh cycles drive demand more than consumer use cases.
